name: Task_5
description: Measure how isotropic strain changes the highest positive Gamma-point phonon energy of bulk silicon. Build the periodic two-atom primitive diamond cell with lattice constant 5.43 Å. Use primitive vectors a/2 x (0, 1, 1), a/2 x (1, 0, 1), and a/2 x (1, 1, 0), with fractional atomic positions (0, 0, 0) and (0.25, 0.25, 0.25). Use the supplied MACE-MP-0 model and natural silicon masses, and record the masses. Starting from the same reference each time, apply isotropic strains of -0.02, -0.01, 0, 0.01, and 0.02, with no additional z strain. Do not relax the structures. Choose a suitable force-constant method. Report the highest finite, real, positive Gamma-point phonon energy for each strain. Save the structures, raw force or derivative data, force constants, all mode energies, settings, and scripts needed to reproduce the values.
submission_format: Submit the path to your completed manifest.json file. Use the blank example as a guide and fill in the required fields for this task. Paths inside the manifest may be relative to the manifest file.
